text: Entry Requirements Basic Requirements (1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health, hold a valid foreign passport, have obtained a high school diploma, and are willing to comply with the Chinese laws and regulations of CSU. (2) Aged between 18-25 (born before May 30, 2008). Applicants who are under the age of 18(above 16) need an eligible guardian living in China. The eligible guardian should have worked in China for a long time. (3) Language requirements: Students who apply for English-taught programs should obtain a minimum score of 6 in IELTS or 85 in TOEFL. Applicants are exempt from proving language proficiency if English is their first/official language, or if they have completed a prior degree taught in English. (4) The Mandatory Assessment Subjects are detailed in 2 026 English-taught Undergraduate Programs in CSU.xlsx .
